description: Three settings simplification proposals, based on the existing Basic/Advanced implementation. Design mockups only; values are illustrative and the app behavior is unchanged.
recommendation: Use compact essentials for an incremental change; use one settings view for a broader redesign. Guided setup is optional onboarding and should not replace direct editing for returning users.

concepts.title: Compact essentials
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity concept screenshot of OpenWhisper desktop settings.
Input images: supplied screenshots are style and product references, not edit targets.
Style: match OpenWhisper's existing dark charcoal canvas, near-black header, midnight navy panels, electric blue selected controls, pale text, muted gray descriptions, subtle slate borders and small blue/purple outline icons. Practical native desktop utility with restrained 10px corner radii, crisp modern sans-serif text and clean alignment. This is a design proposal; example values are illustrative.
Composition: one complete front-facing desktop app window, landscape approximately 1400 by 1000, with a narrow neutral dark margin. Large readable UI type, all content and footer fit. No device, desk, scene, perspective, illustration, gradients or decorative marketing text.
Header uses existing blue microphone app icon, exact brand "OpenWhisper" and secondary "Settings". Native close icon.
Constraints: recognizable OpenWhisper visual identity; credible desktop controls; no invented plan/tier/pricing; no clipped content; no unreadable fine print. Preserve a clear distinction between local speech transcription and cloud text cleanup.
Primary request: a smaller, calmer iteration of the existing Basic settings page. Keep Basic and Advanced. Show only the everyday dictation controls, moving rarely used controls into two collapsed sections.
Header right: segmented control "Basic" selected blue and "Advanced" gray.
Below header: horizontal tabs "Dictation" selected blue, "Meetings", "App". A compact search field at the right, "Search settings" with "Ctrl+K".
Body heading "Dictation" with one short subtitle "Your everyday voice typing settings."
Content uses one centered column of two understated panels with uniform right-aligned controls, enough room for readable text and 32px spacing. Small panel headers, avoid a card per setting.
Panel "Recording":
row "Microphone", dropdown "System default";
row "Recording shortcut", outlined shortcut pill "Ctrl + Alt + R" and small "Change" button.
Panel "Text":
row "Speech engine", dropdown "Parakeet", short green secondary note "Audio stays on this computer";
row "Clean up dictation", blue ON switch; under label short explanatory text "Fix punctuation and formatting"; under it visible muted amber privacy note "Transcript text is sent to OpenRouter";
indented dependent row visible because cleanup is ON: "Cleanup level", compact segmented choices "Light", "Medium", "High" with "Medium" selected blue;
row "Paste automatically", blue ON switch.
Then two closed accordion rows at the same column width with right-facing chevrons:
"Personalize" with muted summary "Dictionary, snippets, styles and commands";
"More options" with muted summary "Live transcript, recording overlay and model details".
Both accordion rows remain closed, without extra setting controls.
Footer muted "Changes save automatically" at left, "Done" button at right.
Avoid repetition: no separate setup links under every group, no model version strings, catalog counts, endpoints, hardware or runtime details. Preserve 5 main rows plus the one cleanup-dependent row exactly. Render specified strings accurately.

concepts.title: One settings view
Guided setup
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity concept screenshot of OpenWhisper desktop settings.
Input images: supplied screenshots are style and product references, not edit targets.
Style: match OpenWhisper's existing dark charcoal canvas, near-black header, midnight navy panels, electric blue selected controls, pale text, muted gray descriptions, subtle slate borders and small blue/purple outline icons. Practical native desktop utility with restrained 10px corner radii, crisp modern sans-serif text and clean alignment. This is a design proposal; example values are illustrative.
Composition: one complete front-facing desktop app window, landscape approximately 1400 by 1000, with a narrow neutral dark margin. Large readable UI type, all content and footer fit. No device, desk, scene, perspective, illustration, gradients or decorative marketing text.
Header uses existing blue microphone app icon, exact brand "OpenWhisper" and secondary "Settings". Native close icon.
Constraints: recognizable OpenWhisper visual identity; credible desktop controls; no invented plan/tier/pricing; no clipped content; no unreadable fine print. Preserve a clear distinction between local speech transcription and cloud text cleanup.
Primary request: show an OPTIONAL guided setup within OpenWhisper Settings that helps new users configure dictation one decision at a time. This is a proposed flow, not an existing feature. Familiar visual identity, a very calm central setup panel. Do not add chatbots, natural-language settings commands or arbitrary automatic AI recommendations.
Header right text link "All settings".
Below header modest breadcrumb "Dictation / Guided setup".
Heading "Set up dictation" and subtitle "Choose how your spoken words become text."
A horizontal three-step stepper, well spaced across the content:
step 1 checked "Audio"; step 2 blue circle "Text" active; step 3 gray circle "Output". Thin line connects circles.
One large central panel heading "How much cleanup would you like?"
Short helper "Choose how closely the transcript follows your words."
Top row "Use AI cleanup" with blue ON toggle on the right.
Under it three equal-width choice tiles, just text, no decorative artwork:
"Light" / "Punctuation & fillers";
"Medium" / "Corrections & lists", this tile selected with blue border and discreet check;
"High" / "Tighter wording".
Below options a subtle full-width sample preview box, two columns, labels "What you say" and "Your transcript".
What you say sample exactly: "Meet at two, actually three."
Your transcript sample exactly: "Meet at 3."
Make samples noticeably larger than helper text, approximately 18px.
Below preview a visible amber note "Transcript text is sent to OpenRouter."
One compact connected-provider row "OpenRouter" with small green "Connected" badge and right-aligned link "Change".
Footer inside content: left button "Back", right primary blue button "Continue".
Window bottom left muted "You can change these choices later." and bottom right subtle link "Skip setup".
Do not show all recording, output, model catalogs or technical settings simultaneously. No API key entry, no provider endpoint URLs. Match this optional focused flow to the existing settings style and render exact UI labels correctly.

behavior_notes: Collapsed sections must remain keyboard accessible and settings search should reveal and focus the matching control.
Keep one shared settings store and preserve existing save handlers and destination deep links.
Show cleanup-dependent choices only while cleanup is enabled.
Keep accurate provider-specific privacy text visible alongside cloud controls.
Connections groups API keys, remote engine pairing and MCP; Models groups downloads and runtime settings; App includes appearance, hotkeys, backup and developer options.
Try on sample text and guided setup are proposed additions; they are not existing implemented behaviors.
In guided setup, turning AI cleanup off should hide cleanup choices and provider setup. Sample preview is illustrative, not a guarantee of exact model output.
